items.information:
This competition is being held at a rented Villa. 

Mumbai Winter Open 2024 is not just your ordinary WCA Cube Competition. 
Since this is the last competition of the year we would like to celebrate end of 2024 with all of you. 

The competion will have some additional perks included in your reg fee for all partciipants, 
1. Complimentary Coffee + Refreshments (Water, Mocktails, etc.)
2. Complimentary Snacks (Chips, Dips, Candy & More)

Participants have to carry their own puzzles (cubes)

Check out all the other tabs for more information.
